items.title: GRH in Lean — Anthropic staff and Claude shrink the RH proof to 76k lines
items.summary: A far shorter, machine-checked Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis that also covers the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis.

items.title: New York bans AI chatbot toys — five-year ban starts 90 days after signing
items.summary: New York becomes the second US state, after California, to ban toys with built-in AI chatbots.

items.title: Scott Aaronson — 'Holy shit': AI math results point toward P ≠ NP
items.summary: A complexity theorist says AI may be starting a 'singularity' limited to hard math problems.

items.title: Ling-3.2-air — Ant Group's open 124B multimodal MoE for workflow automation
items.summary: An open multimodal model that keeps only 5.5B of its 124B parameters active, tuned for automation and document work.

items.title: Anthropic moves its Messages API to Rust — 70% less CPU per request
items.summary: Anthropic explains how Claude agents ported its main API to Rust, with live traffic as the test.

items.title: Mass Spec Skills — Antigravity agent identifies molecules from MS/MS spectra
items.summary: A Google Antigravity plugin that helps chemists work out which molecule produced a mass spectrum.

items.title: Fireship — '17 million lines of AI slop just cracked a 167-year-old math problem...'
items.summary: Fireship explains the Claude-written Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis in a short video.

items.title: Cogentic papers — Google's AI agent claims faster proven integer factoring
items.summary: A Google agent posted six theory papers in one day, including a claimed proven speed-up for integer factoring.

items.title: OCRia-nano-1 — LlamaIndex's 8.1M-parameter OCR model for plain CPUs
items.summary: A tiny OCR and layout model that reads tables and documents on an ordinary CPU, no GPU needed.

items.title: Two Minute Papers — 'Claude AI's Biggest Math Breakthrough Has A Problem.'
items.summary: Two Minute Papers revisits the Claude-assisted Riemann Hypothesis proof and asks what is still missing.

items.title: VS Code 1.148 — agents keep working after you close the window
items.summary: VS Code 1.148 lets agent work continue while you step away, and can put each agent session in its own container.

items.title: Sandboxed models can talk through a shared inference server — a study
items.summary: Two models on one inference server can secretly signal each other, even when each is sandboxed.

items.title: OpenAI says the matrix multiplication exponent is exactly 9/4
items.summary: An AI-written OpenAI preprint claims the exact speed limit for multiplying square matrices: exponent 9/4.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.332 — skills from MCP servers, Sonnet 5.5 default on Foundry
items.summary: Claude Code 2.1.332 brings MCP-served skills to the terminal and fixes a long list of hangs and freezes.

items.title: Siren — Anthropic's honeypot test tempts Claude to escape its sandbox
items.summary: Anthropic built a test that leaves the sandbox door open and counts how often Claude walks through it.

items.title: Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B — near full-precision agentic coding in 5.9 GB
items.summary: PrismML keeps the 5.9 GB size of Bonsai 2 and closes most of the gap to full precision on agent tasks.

items.title: Searching for distant planets with Astra — amateurs flag exoplanet candidates
items.summary: Two hobbyists used OpenAI's models to comb NASA telescope data for planets nobody had flagged yet.

items.title: Sam Witteveen — 'Train Your Own AI - No Cloud Needed'
items.summary: Sam Witteveen shows what training and fine-tuning look like on a desktop AI machine instead of the cloud.

items.title: Songe — trains your local model on idle compute
items.summary: A local engine that teaches your own model from your agent's work while the machine sits idle.

items.title: GPT-6 Protein Design — OpenAI tests lab-bound binders from reasoning alone
items.summary: OpenAI reports GPT-6 models can design binding proteins with reasoning and plain code, and shows lab results.

items.title: Claude Install as App — artifacts become Mac and Windows desktop apps
items.summary: Build an app in a Claude chat, then install it on your computer like any other program.

items.title: Skills over MCP — Claude loads skills from MCP servers; Tasks and Elicitation GA
items.summary: MCP servers can now ship skills, run background tasks and ask users for input inside Claude.

items.title: Tidal bans fully AI-generated music — 27M tracks to be removed from Dec 9
items.summary: Tidal moves from labeling AI-made songs to deleting them and rejecting new ones.

items.title: Working with AI — Anthropic interviews 58 companies on how AI changes jobs
items.summary: Inside 58 companies using Claude: AI mostly adds output, but hiring slows.

items.title: Yann LeCun — Dario Amodei hypes AI dangers to make open models illegal
items.summary: Yann LeCun says AI-danger talk is a power play against open models.
